companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text: Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
The Global Network Engineering organization is seeking a Lead Network Engineer to provide subject matter expertise in support of the Experian Global Network and voice/video collaboration environment which spans all business units and regions. This role will immediately contribute to several large global programs, including SD-WAN, automation, and standards development across the estate. The role will also work closely with the security, build, and operational teams to maintain a and secure network infrastructure to adhere to stringent Regulatory, Governmental, and Industry security control requirements. Additionally, this role will help us establish an efficient, agile, and engineering team that continues to delight our customers by providing world class service. You will be our Wi-Fi subject matter expert, and this role will be based out of the Experian Cyberjaya Office

What You'll Be Doing

  • You will support and enhance our global network, security, and collaboration environments, helping us maintain reliable and secure services across cloud and on-premises platforms.
  • You will identify opportunities to improve processes, automate repetitive tasks, and optimize the performance and availability of our infrastructure.
  • You will design, implement, and support network, voice, video, and unified communications solutions that enable seamless collaboration for teams across different locations and time zones.
  • You will partner

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
What We're Looking For

  • You have 8+ years of experience designing, provisioning, and managing network technologies within a large, globally distributed environment.
  • You have advanced hands-on experience with Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking, WAN and SD-WAN, traffic prioritisation, cloud networking, and real-time voice and video optimisation, including technologies such as BGP, OSPF, VLANs, QoS and MPLS.
  • You have experience configuring and supporting enterprise network and security technologies, including Check Point firewalls and IPS, Citrix load balancers, and Fortinet wireless solutions, such as FortiManager, FortiGate, FortiNAC, FortiAP and FortiSwitch.
  • You have experience supporting Microsoft Teams Rooms, Teams-certified devices, conference-room audiovisual technologies, and the network requirements for real-time communications.
  • You have led technical work within an engineering team, mentored junior engineers, and produced implementation documentation such as methods of procedure, technical standards, lifecycle plans and Microsoft Visio network diagrams.
  • You hold a Cisco CCNP certification or equivalent skill level and have experience with at least one automation or reporting technology, such as Terraform, Ansible, Python or Power BI.
